issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the Lecture attributes as private (indicated by '-') but the template's Lecture.java declares existing attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents). The solution uses private attributes. This visibility mismatch between the problem UML, the template, and the solution can confuse students about the intended access level and encapsulation (whether fields should be private with getters/setters).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture.java to declare the attributes as private and include the remaining attributes from the UML (numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). Provide the appropriate getter/setter method stubs in the template. This will align the template with the UML in the problem statement and the solution, clarifying the intended encapsulation for students.
